versions.title: Who's who in the Red Chamber

daiyu.title: Lin Daiyu
daiyu.html: Grandmother Jia's granddaughter, brought to the household after her mother dies. Sensitive, quick and the finest poet among them; she grows up beside Baoyu, each the other's only true confidant.

baoyu.title: Jia Baoyu
baoyu.html: Son of Jia Zheng and Lady Wang, born with jade in his mouth and his grandmother's favourite. He scorns an official career and loves Daiyu, yet is matched with Baochai.

brief.subject: The Jia household in Dream of the Red Chamber
brief.intent: How the central characters are related, by blood and by heart
brief.concept: Three rows by generation with the ties written on the lines; Baoyu in the middle, and the one vermilion line, to Daiyu, is the heart of the book
brief.direction: Fine-line ink portraits, kaishu names, a single touch of vermilion
